# mspTools

A biology-focused library of functions to analyze, visualize and report
proteomics data.

# Installation

You can install this package from GitHub via:

    devtools::install_github("nicohuttmann/mspTools")

or the new, fast way:

    pak::pkg_install("nicohuttmann/mspTools")

mspTools is the biology-facing layer of the msVerse. It builds on
[msTools](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/msTools/) and
[msArrow](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/msArrow/), adding annotation
retrieval and the plots that depend on it.

# What is here

|             |                                                  |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Annotations | UniProt, GO and InterPro retrieval and curation  |
| Heatmaps    | `ComplexHeatmap` wrappers over the dataset store |
| PELSA       | plots for PELSA-style experiments                |

Some annotation functions depend on Bioconductor packages
(`AnnotationDbi`, `GO.db`, `ComplexHeatmap`); install those first if
they are not already present.

See the [reference](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/)
for the full list.

# Package index

## UniProt

Retrieving and reshaping UniProt records.

- [`get_UniProt_data()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/get_UniProt_data.md)
  : Download UniProt data for given protein accessions and data fields
  (see available fields with UniProt_fields())
- [`get_UniProt_data_o()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/get_UniProt_data_o.md)
  : Download UniProt data for given protein accessions, taxonomy
  identifiers and data fields (faster for 1000s of proteins; see
  available fields with UniProt_fields())
- [`get_UniProt_data_1o()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/get_UniProt_data_1o.md)
  : Download UniProt data for given protein accessions, multiple
  taxonomy identifiers and data fields (faster for 1000s of proteins;
  see available fields with UniProt_fields())
- [`UniProt_fields()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/UniProt_fields.md)
  : Return list of vectors of UniProt data fields

## Gene Ontology

GO annotation extracted from UniProt records, with ancestor expansion
and ontology filtering.

- [`UniProt_to_T2GO()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/UniProt_to_T2GO.md)
  : Title
- [`extract_UniProt_GO2list()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/extract_UniProt_GO2list.md)
  : Title
- [`extract_UniProt_GO2TERM2GENE()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/extract_UniProt_GO2TERM2GENE.md)
  : Title
- [`GO_add_ancestors()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/GO_add_ancestors.md)
  : Title
- [`GO_append_description()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/GO_append_description.md)
  : Title
- [`GO_filter_ontology()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/GO_filter_ontology.md)
  : Title

## InterPro

- [`get_InterPro_data_from_UniProt()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/get_InterPro_data_from_UniProt.md)
  : Title
- [`download_UniParc_sequence_features()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/download_UniParc_sequence_features.md)
  : Download sequence features data for UniParc sequences

## Protein sequence plots

PELSA-style figures showing peptides and annotated features along a
protein sequence.

- [`plot_protein_sequence()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/plot_protein_sequence.md)
  : Plot PELSA results on a protein sequence including protein domain
  features
- [`.plot_peptides_on_seq()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-plot_peptides_on_seq.md)
  : Title
- [`.plot_protein_features()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-plot_protein_features.md)
  : Title
- [`.plot_protein_seq()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-plot_protein_seq.md)
  : Title
- [`.extract_UniProt_seqinfo()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-extract_UniProt_seqinfo.md)
  : Extract sequence-specific UniProt information from downloaded data
- [`.identify_UniProt_infotype()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-identify_UniProt_infotype.md)
  : Title

## Heatmaps

- [`cheatmap()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/cheatmap.md)
  : Title

## Plotting helpers

The EMBL palette and axis helpers. Colour meanings are fixed per project
in `00_Setup.R`, so these give the palette rather than hardcoded hex.

- [`scale_color_embl()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/scale_color_embl.md)
  : ggplot2 'color' color palette based on EMBL colors from
  https://www.embl.org/guidelines/design/design-guidelines/colours/
- [`scale_fill_embl()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/scale_fill_embl.md)
  : \#' ggplot2 'fill' color palette based on EMBL colors from
  https://www.embl.org/guidelines/design/design-guidelines/colours/
- [`.align_axes_limits()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-align_axes_limits.md)
  : Align axis limits of a list of plots
- [`.axis_limit_breaks()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-axis_limit_breaks.md)
  : Helps make nice axis limit breaks
- [`.get_plot_limits()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-get_plot_limits.md)
  : Title
- [`.rcol()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-rcol.md)
  : Returns a randomly generated vector of colors sorted by hue
- [`.set_continuous_axes()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-set_continuous_axes.md)
  : Defines ggplot panel by ratio, size, unit size, center, and axis
  breaks
- [`.set_PCA_labs()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-set_PCA_labs.md)
  : Title

## Small helpers

- [`bin_percent()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/bin_percent.md)
  : Title
- [`max_2()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/max_2.md)
  : Calculate maximum along two vectors
- [`min_2()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/min_2.md)
  : Calculate minimum along two vectors
- [`rev_lvl()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/rev_lvl.md)
  : Reverse the factor level order

## Scripts and code

- [`backup_scripts()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/backup_scripts.md)
  : Title
- [`.cat_contrasts.fit()`](https://nicohuttmann.github.io/mspTools/reference/dot-cat_contrasts.fit.md)
